name: wallet_asset_portfolio
description: Get balances for the currently selected supported chain from native chain RPC nodes only. Provide selected_chain_id plus an addresses map that contains the selected chain address. The tool returns that chain's native asset and tracked token balances without querying third-party pricing platforms.

selected_chain_id.description: The chain to show detailed balances for, such as ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, bsc, polygon, avalanche, or numeric chain IDs like 1 and 8453.

addresses.description: Map of chain IDs to wallet addresses, for example {"ethereum":"0x...","8453":"0x..."}.
